text: I haven’t cried like that in years. In a good way. I left feeling lighter than I have since before the baby.
Okay I have to tell you something.
I used the breathwork thing in the car before my interview today. Hands were shaking, heart going crazy, the whole thing. Four counts in, hold, six out, like you showed us.
I walked in calm. Like actually calm. And I got the job!!
Thank you for giving me something I can take with me.
Best Thursday of my whole week. Same time next week?
Three days in the mountains and I finally remembered what my body feels like when it isn’t bracing for something.
I didn’t realize how long I’d been holding my breath. Not just in class. In my life.
Already counting down to the next one.
My team still talks about it. Best offsite we’ve done, and nobody had to do a trust fall.
Just wanted to say thank you. That’s it. That’s the text.
